title: hold.closed v1
description: A hold closes. The subject is the hold.

rule_id.description: The rule that caused the hold, where one applies.

credential_id.description: The credential that caused the hold, where one applies.

lease_seat_id.description: The builder seat given a fresh lease by this event, or null when it gives none. Replay sets the task's holder from it. Set by Offer task again.

wait_cause.description: Why the wait_ready step this event opens is waiting: credential_limit when no seat is eligible only because no candidate is available and none is signed out, else null. Null when the event opens no wait_ready step. Fixed when the step opens (PRD, Rules for steps, rule 8).
